gates.summary: Live tiles follow the model's tile geometry (late selection, partial edges, stage changes); completed comparisons stay responsive while another job runs; folder jobs save together; queue estimates separate measured from unmeasured work.
gates.next_action: Repeat the recorded cases on each new package.

gates.summary: The macOS beta is Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled. Images, video, cancellation, worker recovery, the in-app update and the system-codec route passed on an M1 Pro.
gates.next_action: Keep the accepted hashes; re-run the trust checks on every new build.

gates.summary: The beta feed is live on the website. Downloads are verified by size, SHA-256 and minisign signature; truncated and substituted archives are rejected; settings, recipes and the queue are backed up before an install.
gates.next_action: Publish every future entry only after installing it from the feed on a test machine.

gates.summary: A complete five-minute 480p clip exported at 2x on ROCm (9,000 frames, audio intact); a six-frame 4K to 8K export and recovery from a forced output-size failure passed.
gates.next_action: Keep the workload limits documented; a full 4K export of several minutes has not been exercised.

gates.summary: NAFNet and SPAN can diverge on some inputs. Bounded retries and a pre-quantization guard reject unstable output instead of saving it; two of eleven reproduced scans are rejected.
gates.next_action: Document the rejection limit and keep the originals.

gates.summary: Every catalog download names its author, source and license. NomosWebPhoto and HFA2k download under the author's CC BY 4.0 terms with attribution; the two HAT face checkpoints require a verified user import; no weights are bundled.
gates.next_action: Keep the notices in sync with the catalog.

gates.summary: The royalty-free media runtime does not build on Windows yet, so no Windows package passes the codec gate. CPU and DirectML test builds passed installed acceptance on Windows 11 with an Intel UHD 620. CUDA also waits for NVIDIA's confirmation on cuDNN 9 DLL redistribution.
gates.next_action: Port packaging/ffmpeg/build_lgpl_media.py to Windows, rebuild the CPU and DirectML workers, repeat the installed checks and publish the direct installers with the SmartScreen notice.

gates.summary: CPU, CUDA and ROCm AppImages build with verified production update signatures. CPU and ROCm passed installed worker acceptance on Fedora 44. The GPU packages are 5 to 6 GB and need the release host.
gates.next_action: Rebuild from the released source, host the files, verify the installed upgrade and the folder dialog in a desktop session, then publish.

gates.summary: macOS is published through the website. Windows and Linux downloads and the Microsoft Store listing (HerRei.LocalSR) are not published.
gates.next_action: Publish Windows and Linux once their gates pass; submit the Store package after the website release.

gates.summary: docs/licensing-media.md lists the open questions on demuxing patent-encumbered formats, running a user-installed FFmpeg, MPEG-2/AC-3 patent expiry and NVIDIA library terms.
gates.next_action: Put the questions to an IP lawyer before promoting the beta beyond a small circle of testers.

gates.summary: NVIDIA CUDA, Linux Intel XPU and DirectML adapters other than the UHD 620 have not run on physical hardware.
gates.next_action: Collect volunteer hardware reports before describing these engines as tested.

gates.summary: HDR preservation, SeedVR2 3B, de-flicker and video face processing ship as Labs features. Perceptual HDR quality and long-clip temporal stability are unverified.
gates.next_action: Recommend short clips and state the memory and time limits in the app.
